ent-mart_customer_lifetime_value-367ec7.description: Reverse-engineered View parsed via SQLGlot AST (3 upstream source tables)

columns.description: Projected view expression: c.Customer Identifier
Projected view expression: c.Customer Full Name
Projected view expression: c.Customer Status Code
Projected view expression: COUNT(o.Order Key)
Projected view expression: Minute(d.Calendar Date)
Projected view expression: Maximum(d.Calendar Date)
Projected view expression: COALESCE(SUM(o.Total Order Amount), 0.0)
Projected view expression: ROUND(COALESCE(Average(o.Total Order Amount), 0.0), 2)

ent-mart_customer_lifetime_value-367ec7.view_sql:
SELECT
  c.CUST_ID AS CUSTOMER_KEY,
  c.CUST_FULL_NM AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
  c.CUST_STAT_CD AS CUSTOMER_STATUS,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_KEY) AS LIFETIME_ORDERS_COUNT,
  MIN(d.CALENDAR_DATE) AS FIRST_PURCHASE_DATE,
  MAX(d.CALENDAR_DATE) AS LATEST_PURCHASE_DATE,
  COALESCE(SUM(o.TOTAL_ORDER_AMT), 0.0) AS LIFETIME_NET_SPEND_AMT,
  ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(o.TOTAL_ORDER_AMT), 0.0), 2) AS AVG_ORDER_BASKET_AMT
FROM DIM_CUSTOMER AS c
LEFT JOIN FCT_ORDERS AS o
  ON c.CUST_ID = o.CUSTOMER_KEY
LEFT JOIN DIM_DATE AS d
  ON o.ORDER_DATE_KEY = d.DATE_KEY
GROUP BY
  c.CUST_ID,
  c.CUST_FULL_NM,
  c.CUST_STAT_CD

ent-mart_monthly_revenue_kpis-a447bc.logical_name: Mart Monthly Revenue Key Performance Indicators
ent-mart_monthly_revenue_kpis-a447bc.description: Reverse-engineered View parsed via SQLGlot AST (2 upstream source tables)

columns.description: Projected view expression: d.Calendar Year
Projected view expression: d.Month Name
Projected view expression: COUNT(o.Order Key)
Projected view expression: SUM(o.Total Order Amount)
Projected view expression: SUM(o.Tax Amount)
Projected view expression: SUM(o.Shipping Amount)
Projected view expression: COUNT(DISTINCT o.Customer Key)

ent-mart_monthly_revenue_kpis-a447bc.view_sql:
SELECT
  d.CALENDAR_YEAR AS REPORTING_YEAR,
  d.MONTH_NAME AS REPORTING_MONTH,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_KEY) AS TOTAL_ORDERS_COUNT,
  SUM(o.TOTAL_ORDER_AMT) AS GROSS_REVENUE_AMT,
  SUM(o.TAX_AMT) AS TOTAL_TAX_AMT,
  SUM(o.SHIPPING_AMT) AS TOTAL_SHIPPING_AMT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.CUSTOMER_KEY) AS ACTIVE_BUYING_CUSTOMERS
FROM FCT_ORDERS AS o
INNER JOIN DIM_DATE AS d
  ON o.ORDER_DATE_KEY = d.DATE_KEY
GROUP BY
  d.CALENDAR_YEAR,
  d.MONTH_NAME,
  d.MONTH_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  d.CALENDAR_YEAR,
  d.MONTH_NUMBER

columns.description: Projected view expression: p.Category Name

Projected view expression: SUM(oi.Gross Profit Amount)
Projected view expression: ROUND(Average(oi.Unit Selling Price Amount), 2)

ent-mart_product_category_performance-13.view_sql:
SELECT
  p.CATEGORY_NAME AS PRODUCT_CATEGORY,
  COUNT(oi.ORDER_ITEM_KEY) AS ITEMS_SOLD_COUNT,
  SUM(oi.NET_SALES_AMT) AS CATEGORY_NET_SALES_AMT,
  SUM(oi.GROSS_PROFIT_AMT) AS CATEGORY_GROSS_PROFIT_AMT,
  ROUND(AVG(oi.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE_AMT), 2) AS AVG_SELLING_PRICE_AMT
FROM FCT_ORDER_ITEMS AS oi
INNER JOIN DIM_PRODUCT AS p
  ON oi.PRODUCT_KEY = p.PRODUCT_KEY
GROUP BY
  p.CATEGORY_NAME

columns.description: Projected view expression: c.Customer Identifier

Projected view expression: COUNT(f.Claim Transaction Identifier)
Projected view expression: SUM(f.Claim Paid Amount)

ent-vw_customer_claim_summary-2a8691.view_sql:
SELECT
  c.CUST_ID AS CUST_ID,
  c.CUST_FULL_NM AS CUST_FULL_NM,
  p.PLCY_NBR AS PLCY_NBR,
  COUNT(f.CLM_TXN_ID) AS TOTAL_CLM_CNT,
  SUM(f.CLM_PAID_AMT) AS TOTAL_CLM_PAID_AMT
FROM DIM_CUSTOMER AS c
INNER JOIN DIM_INSURANCE_POLICY AS p
  ON c.CUST_ID = p.CUST_ID
LEFT JOIN FCT_CLAIM_TRANSACTION AS f
  ON p.PLCY_ID = f.PLCY_ID
GROUP BY
  c.CUST_ID,
  c.CUST_FULL_NM,
  p.PLCY_NBR
